task.description: WF-03 Step 0.5: Register ISS-0709 for the VLD-01/02/03 implementation defect and file a GitHub issue. The defect: 10 in-file unit tests inside src/validation/{site,pd06,typecheck,mod}_test.zig fail with runtime panic / assertion errors. The strongest signal: 'mod.test.validateDefinition: clean linear definition with one guard -> expected 0, found 3' — the implementation reports findings on a definition that should be valid. This blocks the VLD-01/02/03 release because (a) the unit test gate is RED, and (b) the helper modules (site, pd06, typecheck) don't behave as their tests expect, so the validator's end-to-end ACs cannot be verified. Steps: (1) Read the existing ISS schema (use ISS-0708.json as template). (2) Create docs/issues/ISS-0709.json with the proper schema. (3) Run `gh issue create` to file on GitHub with title 'VLD-01/02/03 implementation: validateDefinition returns findings on clean definitions (4 fail + 2 crash in src/validation/*.zig)', body summarizing the failure table from tests/reports/WF02-vld01-03-20260816-test-report.md §1 and §3.1, labels ['bug', 'wf03', 'vld', 'stage-16']. Capture the issue URL. (4) Update ISS-0709.json with the GitHub issue URL. (5) Run `python tools/lint_handoffs.py` to confirm clean.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub issue filed with title, body (failure table + classification), labels
